meaning:
§ Dothan = "two wells"
a place in northern Palestine, 12 miles north of Samaria, the home of Elisha

elsewhere.note: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ ” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”
